name: Bullish and Bearish Engulfing
summary: This EA detects bullish and bearish engulfing candlestick patterns to generate trade signals. It enters long positions on bullish engulfing patterns and short positions on bearish engulfing patterns. The strategy relies purely on price action candlestick recognition without additional indicator confirmation.
summary_zh: 该EA通过识别看涨吞没和看跌吞没K线形态来生成交易信号。在检测到看涨吞没形态时开多仓，在检测到看跌吞没形态时开空仓。策略完全依赖裸K形态识别，不使用额外指标确认。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于经典的吞没K线形态识别，看涨吞没要求当前阳线实体完全包裹前一根阴线实体，看跌吞没则相反。入场条件为形态完成后立即开仓，做多对应看涨吞没，做空对应看跌吞没。出场条件依赖于止损和止盈参数的设定，缺乏基于形态的动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面较为简单，仅依赖固定止损控制单笔风险，未考虑整体敞口或连亏控制。整体策略逻辑直观但单一，缺少过滤条件和多时间框架确认，容易在震荡行情中产生大量虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on classic engulfing candlestick pattern recognition, where a bullish engulfing requires the current bullish candle body to completely engulf the previous bearish candle body, and vice versa for bearish engulfing. Entry conditions trigger immediately upon pattern completion, going long on bullish engulfing and short on bearish engulfing. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters, lacking any dynamic exit mechanism based on pattern context or trailing logic. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is rudimentary, depending solely on a fixed stop-loss for per-trade risk control without considering overall exposure or consecutive loss limits. The overall strategy logic is straightforward but singular, lacking filters and multi-timeframe confirmation, making it prone to numerous false signals in choppy markets.

parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于经典K线形态，易于理解和验证
吞没形态是高可靠性的反转信号，在趋势末端具有较好的胜率
代码结构简单，便于修改和添加过滤条件
固定止损止盈提供了基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on classic candlestick patterns, easy to understand and verify
Engulfing patterns are relatively reliable reversal signals with decent win rates at trend exhaustion points
Clean code structure that is easy to modify and extend with additional filters
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 缺少趋势过滤和多重确认机制，在震荡市中频繁产生虚假信号
固定手数不适应不同账户规模和波动率环境，资金管理粗糙
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
出场机制仅依赖固定止损止盈，未利用吞没形态的目标位进行动态出场
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Lacks trend filters and multi-confirmation mechanisms, generating frequent false signals in ranging markets
Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to different account sizes or volatility environments, crude money management
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same candle
Exit mechanism relies solely on fixed SL/TP without dynamic exits based on pattern price targets
Missing spread filter and trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 添加趋势方向过滤（如均线或ATR），仅在顺势方向交易吞没形态
引入动态仓位管理，根据ATR或账户风险比例调整手数
增加新K线检查和持仓检查，避免重复开仓和过度暴露
improvements_en: Add trend direction filters (e.g., moving average or ADX) to trade engulfing patterns only in the trend direction
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage for better money management
Add new bar check and position check to prevent duplicate entries and overexposure

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度暴露
纯K线形态策略在震荡行情中容易连续亏损
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过宽，高波动时止损过窄
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause duplicate position opening on the same candle leading to overexposure
Pure candlestick pattern strategy prone to consecutive losses in choppy/ranging markets
Fixed stop-loss ignores market volatility, too wide in low volatility and too tight in high volatility
